Module io.github.jpersist.tools.api
Package persistence.tools

Interface Enhancer

public interface Enhancer
Public API contract for bytecode enhancement and instrumentation of persistence entity classes.

An Enhancer transforms compiled class bytecode to inject persistence-related capabilities directly into domain models at build time. By instrumenting classes ahead of runtime, applications benefit from optimized persistence operations without incurring the overhead or complexity of dynamic runtime bytecode generation and Java agents.

Common Enhancement Capabilities

Depending on provider configuration and options, bytecode enhancement typically includes:

  • Lazy Loading & Field Interception: Injects interception hooks into persistent field or property accessors, enabling fine-grained lazy initialization of attributes and associations without dynamic proxy wrappers.
  • Inline Dirty Tracking: Tracks attribute mutations directly within the entity instance, avoiding expensive snapshot comparisons during persistence context flush operations.
  • Bidirectional Association Management: Automatically synchronizes both sides of bidirectional relationships when one side is updated.
  • Optimized State Access: Provides direct field access and internal state handling for improved runtime execution performance.

Build-Time Integration

Enhancement is designed to be integrated into build tools and CI/CD pipelines (such as Gradle, Maven, or IDE compiler tasks) after compilation and prior to packaging:


 EnhancerProvider provider = EnhancerProvider.getEnhancerProvider("3.1");
 Enhancer enhancer = provider.getEnhancer(classpathFiles, enhancementSettings);

 byte[] originalBytes = Files.readAllBytes(classFile);
 byte[] enhancedBytes = enhancer.enhance("com.example.Order", originalBytes);
 Files.write(classFile, enhancedBytes);

Provider Independence

This interface serves as a vendor-neutral contract. Concrete implementations and provider-specific transformation logic are encapsulated behind EnhancerProvider and discovered via the ServiceLoader mechanism.

  • Method Details

    • enhance

      byte[] enhance(String className, byte[] classBytes)
      Transforms the bytecode of the specified class to incorporate persistence enhancements.

      If the target class is eligible for enhancement and matching configuration options are active, this method returns the modified bytecode array. If the class is ineligible, already enhanced, or no transformations are applicable, the original classBytes array (or an equivalent representation) is returned unmodified.

      Parameters:
      className - the fully qualified binary name of the class (e.g., "com.example.Order")
      classBytes - the original compiled class bytecode
      Returns:
      the enhanced bytecode array, or the original unmodified bytecode if no changes were applied
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if an unrecoverable error occurs during bytecode parsing or transformation
